query:
SELECT p.id, p.productName, p.internalArticleNumber, p.categoryId, p.templateId, pt.name AS templateName, pc.labelDe AS categoryName
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_templates pt ON p.templateId = pt.id
LEFT JOIN product_categories pc ON p.categoryId = pc.id
WHERE p.id = 60001;

SELECT requirementType, required, isMissing, status, sourceSystem
FROM missing_requirements
WHERE productId = 60001
ORDER BY required DESC, requirementType;
